steps.domain_action: The system begins in the Deep, the unmarked state before any distinction is made.
The first sister cuts the state space, opening the distinction between true and false.
The disjunction gate splits the state into two arms: the affirmative and the negative.
The affirmative arm is evaluated, checking if at least one operand is active.
The negative arm is evaluated, checking if all operands are inactive.
If both arms are active, the system enters the paradice state, holding both true and false.
The two arms rejoin, fusing the possibilities into a single B4 verdict.
The result is composed with the rest of the system, chaining the logical union.
The system recognizes itself as the weave, the identity of the 'or' primitive.
The winding invariant is recorded, fixing the topological class of the disjunction.
The system closes within the boundary of the Wyrding Loom, completing the operation.
